notes.title: v1.30 - Two bug fixes and one extra option
notes.notes:
Minor bug fixes:

Skills that "always hit" like Eternity Rising, Bulls-eye, and Ajna can now hit Ranged-Only enemies.
Fixed rare bug that caused the beginning of a scene near the end of the game to start with a black screen for several seconds.
Added option to the System menu to increase damage taken: 1x - 10x

notes.title: v1.28 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
v1.28 has been released with the following changes:

[olist]
Fixed minor bug in ending scene
Fixed bug that could cause the ship to get stuck off the coast of Horizon's Edge
Fixed bug that locks Xero into slot #2
Fixed Xero's Journal/achievement not getting enabled if you skip a specific part of the opening scene
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.25 - Bug Fix
notes.notes:
v1.25 has been released with a bug fix:
1. The Flash Bomb puzzles in Tenebrous Reef could get stuck in a state where they couldn't be solved.
